paite: Huan Mosi in, Israel mite teng kiang ah hiai thu agen hi.
heading: Joshua In Mosi Tha Akhengkhia
english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

paite: “Tu in kum za-le-sawmnih ka hita a; ka vialvak zou nawn kei. TOUPA'N 'Hiai Jordan lui na kan kei ding,' ahon chi hi.
english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na ma uh api dia, hiai namte ahon hihsiatsak dia, agam uh na luah ding uh. TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in Joshua in na ma uh api ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

paite: TOUPA'N Amorte kumpipa, Sihon leh Og leh agam tung ua ahih bang in atung uah ahih dia; amaute ahihse ding hi.
english: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

paite: TOUPA'N amaute ahon pe dia, thu ka hon piak thupiak tengteng atung uah na hih ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

paite: Kuhkaltak leh hangsantak in om un. Lau kei unla, kihta sam kei un. Na kiang ua hon pepa TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi ngal a. Ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

paite: Mosi in Joshua asam a, Israel mi tengteng mitmuh in akiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Hiai mite toh akiang ua api-le-pute uh TOUPA'N kichiam a piak ana chiamsa gam ah na lut ngeingei ding ua, amaute na luahsak ding ahi.
heading: Mosi In Joshua Thuhilhna
english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which Yahweh has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

paite: Na ma uh pipa TOUPA ahi dia, na kiang ah a-om zel dia, ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding hi. Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n," achi hi.
english: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

paite: Mosi in dan agelh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levi tapa siampute leh Israel upate tengteng apia hi.
heading: Kum Sagihna Teng A Dan Sim Ding
english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

paite: Mosi in, amau thu apia a, "Kum sagih kum, ngaihdam kum teng a Biakbuk Ankuangluina,
english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

paite: mun aseh dia Israel mi tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a hong kilat chiang un, hiai dan Israel tengteng zak in na sim ding uh ahi.
english: when all Israel has come to appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

paite: Mipite, numei leh pasal, na taneu chikchikte uh, na ompih uh gamdang mite, amau angaihkhiak ua, akisin ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan asiam ua, hiai dan thu tengteng pilvangtak a azuihtheihna ding uh leh
english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear Yahweh your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

paite: atate uh athei nailoute'n leng azak ua, Jordan lui kan a na va luah ding uh gam a na ten sung teng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam akisintheihna ding un samkhawm in," achi hi.
english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sih hun ahong naita; Joshua sam inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah va kihil in, amau thu ka pe ding hi,” achi hi. Huchi in Mosi leh Joshua ahoh ua, kihoupihna biakbuk ah ava kihil uhi.
heading: Mosi Kiang A TOUPA Thukhah Nanung
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: TOUPA puanin ah meipi ding in akilak a; meipi ding puanın kongpl lutung ah adingh hi.
english: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah na ihmu ding hi. Hiai mite athou ding ua, ava tenna dingte uh lak ah huai gam pathiante lak ah ang a kawm ding ua, ahon lehngatsan ding ua, ka thukhun akiang ua ka khun abohse ding uh.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in atung uah ka heh dia, ka lehngatsan dia, ka kibuk mangsan dia, hihsiat in a-om ding uh. Thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung uah atung ding hi. Huchi in huai ni in, i Pathian uh i lak ua a-om louh ziak in hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong tung ahi kei maw? achi ding uh.
english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

paite: Pathian dangte lam nga a thil hoih lou ahih ding tengteng uh ziak in huai.ni in ka kibuksan ngeingei ding hi.
english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in 'hiai la gelh inla, Israel suante sinsak inla, akam uah koih in. Hiai la Israel suante kalhna a kei a dia theihpihtu ahihtheihna ding in.
english: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

paite: Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam, nawitui leh khuaizu luang gam ah ka pi a, ne leh ta in a-om ua,.atai ua, ahong thau hial chiang un.pathian dangte lam anga ding ua, a-nna uh asem ding ua, kei hon hehsak ding ua, ka thukhun abohse ding uh'.
english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung ua ahong tun chiang in, hiai la akhelhna uh theihpihtu ahi ding. Asuante kam a pan mangngilh theih ahi kei ding hi. Tu in ka kichiam gam a ka pilut ma him in leng alunggel uh akawidan ka thei hi," achi hi.
english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in, huai la, huai ni mahmah in agelh a, Israel suante asinsak hi.
heading: Mosi Laphuah
english: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

paite: Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah hiai thupiak apia hi. "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Israel suante kiang a ka kichiam bang in huai gam ah na pilut ding hi. Na kiang ah ka om ding," achi hi.
english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in hiai dan thute laibu agelh khit a mansa ahih vek nung in,
english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

paite: TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levite Mosi in thu apia hi.
english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, saying,

paite: "Hiai Dan Bu la unla, noute kalh a theihpihtu hi ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm sik ah koih un.
heading: Levite Thupiak
english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

paite: Na helhatdan uh leh na paupendan uh ka thei hi. Ngai un, tua ka hon dampih lai a bawn TOUPA tung a hel na hi ua; ka sih nung ngial in houh bangchi phet in anasazaw diam aw?
english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against Yahweh. How much more after my death?

paite: "Abil ua zak a hiai thu ka gen a, noute kalh a theihpihtu dia lei leh van ka saptheihna ding in na nam ua intekpen tengteng leh na heutute uh hon samkhawm un.
heading: Israel Upa Thuhilhna
english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

paite: Ka sih nung in nakpitak in na kihihse ding ua, ka hon thupiak lampi a pan na pial ding uh chih ka thei kilkel hi. Atawp chiang ngial in houh thil hoih lou in hon buakkhum dia; na khut thilhih ua hihheh ding in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih ding ziak un," achi hi.
english: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

paite: Mosi in, Israel kikhawmkhawm tengteng zak in hiai la thu abul a pan atawp pha in agen vek hi.
english: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.
